name: Suzuki GS550
engine: 549 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: The GS750's smaller brother, from the same engine family and the same Haynes manual. Overbuilt and long-lived.

A-003.title: Get the service manual
A-003.instructions: Get the Suzuki factory service manual for your year, or the Haynes manual no. 363, which covers the 1976-1982 GS550 and GS750 fours.
A-003.reason: Every torque value, clearance and capacity in this course comes from the manual.

H: NGK B8ES is the plug GS Resources owners name for the 1977 GS550. Check your manual for your year.
Suzuki oil filter 16500-45810 fits the 1977-82 GS550 (Total Motorcycle parts list).
K: EBC FA38 is listed for the 1977-79 front discs (Total Motorcycle parts list).

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
